title: Chat Feedback Endpoint — Cycle 17 Closure
problem: After Cycle 16 made clade-seal a promotion gate, one tracked TODO remained: ChatViewModel.swift:510 `sendFeedback` logged locally but did not wire to a server endpoint, so the seal had to permit one TODO.
root_cause: The BrowserOS chat route had no feedback endpoint, and ChatHistoryService had no method to store message-level feedback. The Swift client therefore had no destination for its thumbs-up/down calls.
fix: Added POST /:conversationId/messages/:messageId/feedback to the chat route, protected by requireTrustedAppOrigin. Added ChatHistoryService.storeFeedback that updates metadata.feedback JSONB. Wired ChatViewModel.sendFeedback to POST to ProjectPaths.mcpBaseURL with NetworkRetrier. Emptied ALLOWED_TODO_FINGERPRINTS in clade-seal.

tests.clade_audit: TODO gate 0 findings, all hard gates green

next_options: Extend feedback into signed receipts with dedicated table (Variant B)
Add offline feedback queue with retry
